in_arabic.name: مسكية
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'm-s-k' which means 'sweet, pleasant, delicious, honey, syrup, or sugar'. It can be used as a feminine name.

in_urdu.name: مسکیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'm-s-k' which means 'sweet, pleasant, delicious, honey, syrup, or sugar'. In Urdu, it can be translated to 'meetha' (sweet), 'saa'insiyah' (delicious), or 'shahrbani' (city-dweller). It can be used as a feminine name.

in_hindi.name: मसकीया
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'm-s-k' which means 'sweet, pleasant, delicious, honey, syrup, or sugar'. In Hindi, it can be translated to 'metha' (sweet), 'sukhi' (happy), or 'madhur' (sweet). It can be used as a feminine name.

in_pashto.name: مسکيه
in_pashto.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'm-s-k' which means 'sweet, pleasant, delicious, honey, syrup, or sugar'. In Pashto, it can be translated to 'dalkhwahe' (beloved), 'saa'insiye' (delicious), or 'shahrban' (city-dweller). It can be used as a feminine name.
